name: Academic Achievement Center
description: Academic coaching, workshops, peer mentoring through UConn Connects, and supplemental instruction to help you build study strategies and reach academic goals.

name: Biology Tutoring Center (B Center)
description: Free peer tutoring for life science courses listed under BIOL, EEB, MCB, and PNB. Check the campus page for current availability and details.
eligibility: Students taking eligible UConn Hartford biology courses

name: Quantitative Learning Center (Q Center)
description: Peer tutoring and review sessions for quantitative intensive undergraduate courses. Consult the schedule page to find current sessions and appointment options.
eligibility: UConn Hartford undergraduate students in supported courses

name: Writing Center
description: Undergraduate and graduate tutors can work with you at any stage of an assignment, from early ideas to drafts. The center also offers e-tutoring; check the site for current hours and booking details.

name: Mental Health Resource Center
description: A campus Mental Health Case Manager can talk through concerns affecting student life and connect you with campus or community resources. Contact the office to schedule an appointment; the site describes urgent referral options.
cost: Campus support; ask about any outside service costs

name: UConn Hartford Student Services
description: A welcoming place to start if you are unsure which campus office can help. Student Services can route questions about personal issues, academics, student life, and other campus services.

name: Financial Aid at UConn Hartford
description: For questions about financial aid, start with UConn Hartford's financial aid information and contact options. Ask the office about your individual eligibility, deadlines, and available aid.

name: Find Food & Meal Assistance
description: UConn Hartford Advocacy & Community Engagement links students to local food and meal assistance resources. Follow the official page to see current referrals and details before visiting a provider.
cost: Varies by provider; many food assistance programs are free

name: 2-1-1 Connecticut Resource Finder
description: Search Connecticut community services, including food, housing, utility, and other basic-needs support. Call 2-1-1 or use the online directory to confirm eligibility and availability.
eligibility: Anyone in Connecticut; individual programs set their own eligibility

name: Career Services
description: UConn Hartford Student Services lists Career Services as a campus resource. Use the official student services page to connect with career support and ask about appointments, jobs, resumes, and internships.

name: Student Activities & Organizations
description: Explore student organizations, leadership programs, and activities to meet people and get involved on campus. Check UConn Hartford's university life page for current ways to participate.
cost: Varies by activity; ask the organizer

name: Academic Advising
description: Talk with an assigned advisor about degree progress, requirements, and academic planning. If you are not sure where to begin with a non-advising question, the Office of Student Services can direct you.
eligibility: UConn Hartford undergraduates; some programs have assigned advisors

name: Hartford Public Schools Health Services
description: Hartford Public Schools reports school-based health and dental clinics and school nurses. Contact the district to find the clinic at a student's school and confirm services, hours, and access.
cost: Contact HPS for service and cost details
eligibility: Hartford Public Schools students; access details vary

name: Hartford Public Schools Student Support Services
description: Hartford Public Schools Student Support Services helps students access school programs and services. Contact the department to ask about the right support for a student's needs.

name: Hartford Public Schools Food and Nutrition Services
description: Hartford Public Schools provides meal services at its schools and coordinates with families about dietary and medical food needs. Contact Food and Nutrition Services for current meal information and assistance.
cost: Ask HPS about current meal costs or assistance
eligibility: Hartford Public Schools students; details vary

name: Hartford Public Schools Transportation Services
description: Hartford Public Schools provides student transportation based on school, grade, and distance. Contact the transportation hotline to check a student's eligibility and current routes.
eligibility: Hartford Public Schools students; grade and distance rules apply

name: Hartford Public Schools Enrollment and School Choice
description: Hartford Public Schools' Welcome Center provides enrollment and school choice information, including magnet and open choice options. Contact the office for current deadlines, eligibility, and application help.
eligibility: Hartford students and families; program rules vary

name: MANNA Community Pantry (Hands On Hartford)
description: A community pantry offering groceries, fresh food, and halal options. Hands On Hartford says Connecticut residents can receive an emergency food bag; contact the pantry about enrollment, current hours, and what to bring.
eligibility: Connecticut residents may receive an emergency food bag; pantry enrollment details apply

name: MANNA Community Meals
description: Hands On Hartford serves a free community dinner on Mondays. Check the provider page or call before traveling because hours, location, and service arrangements may change.

name: Hartford Food Access Point Finder
description: The City of Hartford's map helps residents find local food pantries and soup kitchens. Use the live map to check nearby locations and contact providers for current hours and eligibility.

name: Connecticut Foodshare Pantry and Mobile Pantry Locator
description: Search current mobile pantry, food pantry, and community kitchen locations near Hartford. The locator is live; confirm the distribution date, hours, and any requirements before going.
cost: Free food assistance at participating locations

name: House of Bread Community Meals
description: Hartford nonprofit serving a hot, nutritious lunch every day to anyone in need. Check its site or call before visiting for current meal times, location, and access details.
eligibility: Anyone in need; community meals are open to all

name: InterCommunity Health Care – Mental Health Services
description: Affordable behavioral health services include individual and group counseling, psychiatry, child and family therapy, and crisis stabilization. Same-day access may be available; call first to ask about walk-in hours, costs, and eligibility.
cost: Affordable/sliding-fee options; ask about your cost
eligibility: Adults, children, and teens; intake and program requirements apply

name: Capitol Region Mental Health Center
description: State-operated mental health services for Hartford and nearby communities. Contact the center at 860-297-0800 about outpatient care and eligibility. DMHAS lists a 24-hour crisis service at 860-297-0999.
cost: Contact the center about cost and eligibility

name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
description: Call or text 988 for immediate emotional distress or suicide and crisis support. If someone is in immediate physical danger, call 911.

name: Hartford Public Library Events
description: Browse current programs at Hartford Public Library branches, including community, youth, and adult events. Many programs are free; check each event listing for cost, registration, age range, and location.
cost: Many events are free; check the event listing
eligibility: Varies by event; library programs serve the public

name: City of Hartford Community Events
description: Search the City of Hartford's live events directory. It includes community listings and offers an event search with a Free filter. Confirm event details with the organizer.
cost: Use the Free filter; costs vary
eligibility: Open to the community; event-specific rules apply

name: Hartford.com Events and Activations
description: Hartford Business Improvement District calendar for downtown events and activations, including seasonal music, open mics, outdoor movies, and community gatherings. Verify dates and whether an event is free on its listing.
cost: Varies; many seasonal activations are free
eligibility: Public events; organizer rules may apply

name: Hartford Office of Community Engagement
description: City office sharing neighborhood programs, resident events, community engagement opportunities, and practical city resources, including the Hartford Food Access Point finder.
cost: Free information and city programs; check each program
